description: Source code for a WordCloud React component that renders a word cloud visualization using d3-cloud and related libraries, with theme support and data encoding logic.

classes.name: SimpleEncoder
classes.description: A class that maps data fields to visual properties for the word cloud, including scale configuration.

classes.name: WordCloud
classes.description: A React component that generates and renders a word cloud visualization based on provided data and encoding.

methods.name: createEncoder
methods.description: Creates a new SimpleEncoder instance configured with current theme and encoding.

methods.name: setWords
methods.description: Updates the component state with generated words.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Processes data and triggers cloud generation.

methods.name: generateCloud
methods.description: Uses d3-cloud to layout words and recursively refines layout if necessary.
